aggregation.rule: P_k = sigmoid(sum of the k attempts' logits / tau_k)

decision.note: P(right) > 0.5 answers right, < 0.5 left; exactly 0.5 abstains

body_frame.definition: h = (e_z - (e_z.u) u) / |e_z - (e_z.u) u|, s = u x h; roll_rate = w.h, pitch_rate = w.s, acc_lat = a.s, acc_fwd = a.h (device frame, per sample)

input.window: the approach from the detected onset to the detected end, time-normalised to 64 samples (standardize.canonical; README section 3)

model.formula: per member: z-score per channel, 3 x (conv1d same padding, batch norm, ReLU), mean over 8 equal time bins, linear; ensemble logit = mean of the members; then the calibrator

screen_check.rule: median of up_z over the rest before the movement (0.5 s) below the threshold: the screen faces away; multiply the device-frame channels by the screen-flip signs (un-flip) before the model, or ask the user to turn the phone
